_comment: Raw style literals recorded when the KT-Remotion films were committed. ALL of these live in the KT compositions (KTHook / KTTax / KTFxDemo / KTState / KTState3D / KT3DSpike): they were authored as standalone hand-written files during the format's pilot and never went through the @tokens path. This baseline is a DEBT RECORD, not a permission - the ratchet still blocks any increase. Raised 2026-08-06 (7->12 hexTs, 17->28 fontFamilyTs) to land the shipped NO. 026 source, on the same founder call as NO. 031: preserving the only copy of a shipped film beats the refactor. Lower these as the KT files migrate to @tokens and delete this file when they reach zero. The migration needs a render diff afterwards - the films are public, so a token that differs even slightly from the literal changes shipped work.
